entries.title: Prodeus

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with settings and community-map/editor support.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the native PC release, the integrated level-editor/community-map ecosystem, and the strongest capture/settings flexibility; the console and macOS versions do not have exclusive campaign content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Prodeus on Steam for Windows PC and play the current native PC build; use the built-in editor/community-map tools if you want the broadest post-campaign content path.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Elder Veil was announced as DLC, but no playable release is shown on the current Steam DLC page; do not count it as part of the available definitive route until it ships.
